subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) The Oceans are replete (i) of energy (b) The Oceans are rich (ii) with various foods (c) We consume (iii) in mineral water (d) Fish abounds (iv) in the sea (e) At present there is crisis (v) in energy (vi) a little quantity of fish of sweet water
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (ii) The Oceans are replete with various foods. (b) + (v) The Oceans are rich in energy., (c) + (vi) We consume a little quantity of fish of sweet water. (d) + (iv) Fish abounds in the sea. (e) + (i) At present there is crisis of energy.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 143 — Nilphamari Govt. Girls' High School
